visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short brown hair is lying horizontally on a light grey fabric couch. He is wearing a white t-shirt and dark trousers, holding a black smartphone while looking upward with a weary and distressed expression. The background features a modern living room with a geometric-patterned wall and a large abstract pink and white painting. (2) Transition to a bathroom setting where the man is seen in a mirror reflection. He is practicing social greetings, performing various facial expressions including wide smiles, and rehearsing formal bows. The room is brightly lit with white tiles and a large vanity mirror. (3) Back in the living room, the man stands and performs arm stretches. He looks determinedly at the camera with a confident facial expression. A shelf in the background holds a gold trophy and decorative items. (4) A close-up shot focuses on a wooden door handle as it turns. The man is then shown standing in the living room, looking visibly nervous and tense with his hands on his knees as someone enters. (5) A character appears, played by the same man wearing a black wig, glasses with a pearl chain, and a floral blouse. This character acts as an elderly relative, gesturing energetically and touching the man's head. (6) The man presents a large red and cream-colored gift box to the camera. Close-up shots show a red pouch being opened and a golden-brown liquid being poured into a patterned ceramic bowl. (7) The man sits on the couch, holding the product box and speaking directly to the camera with explanatory hand gestures. The lighting is warm and domestic. (8) The floral-clad character is seen performing household chores with a broom and dustpan, appearing fatigued before consuming the product from a pouch and showing a revitalized expression. (9) The man is shown at the entrance of the apartment, placing a product pouch into a white tote bag and then handing a gift bag to an off-screen person before waving goodbye.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a clean indoor room tone. A male voice speaks in a whining, slightly fatigued tone at a moderate speed. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound (Ding / Bell SFX) triggers a shift. The vocal pitch rises as the man mimics different greetings with high energy. A bright, rhythmic acoustic guitar track begins. (3) A mechanical door click SFX marks a transition. A new vocal persona enters: a high-pitched, exaggerated male falsetto with rapid speech and high arousal. The BGM shifts to a more driving hip-hop beat with prominent percussion. (4) Sound of a pouch being torn and liquid pouring (Liquid Pour / Splash SFX). The primary male voice assumes a professional, enunciated narrative tone, describing product features over the steady beat. (5) SFX of swallowing and a satisfied 'ah' vocalization. The auntie character's voice returns with excited exclamations. (6) The video concludes with a rapid-fire sequence of short vocal exchanges and a final door closing impact sound (Hard cut).

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Comedic Skit -> Product Introduction -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a relatable comedic scenario about dreading Mid-Autumn Festival relative interactions to promote 'Fang Zi' Chicken Essence as an ideal gift. By portraying both the stressed nephew and the energetic but demanding auntie, the creator highlights the product's health benefits and convenience.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator provides a dedicated segment explaining product features, nutritional value, and includes a promo code 'DODOMEN'.
